newsitem.title: USA: Sun brings up Pennsylvania cat cracker.
newsitem.headline: Sun brings up Pennsylvania cat cracker.

text.p: Sun Co Inc, confirming its forecast from last week, said it successfully restarted early Monday the 85,000 barrel per day catalytic cracking unit at its Marcus Hook, Pennsylvania refinery following maintenance.
In a prepared statement, the company also said its 80,000 barrel per day crude distillation unit will be returning to service later Monday after its scheduled maintenance.
The cat cracker was off line for 44 days, and traders have said its absence, and that of a number of other downed cat crackers, was felt in tight gasoline markets recently.
